Ojeda II, Army veteran, running in NC-09, with no mention of AI; it does not mention West Virginia, so the identity match to the former West Virginia state senator rests on the background given in the task. As a representative-elect he was not a House member in September 2026 and could not have co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act; no source links him to it or to any AI letter. Search coverage of local North Carolina outlets, debates and interviews was thin, so an AI remark in a debate or interview could have been missed.
